# Videos

You can embed online hosted videos on a site.
Here we show how to do this for youtube videos.

## Embed code

Add the following code to where you want the URL to be embedded. Change the link to the embed link of your video.

```{css, eval=TRUE}
<div class="container">
<iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/U_RkeDVU2cg" 
frameborder="0" allowfullscreen class="video"></iframe>
</div>
```

<div class="container">
<iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/U_RkeDVU2cg" 
frameborder="0" allowfullscreen class="video"></iframe>
</div>

## Styling

To ensure the video embed takes up the entire width of the page you can include the following in your [.scss files](/css/css.qmd).

```{css, eval=FALSE}
.container {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    height: 0;
    padding-bottom: 56.25%;
}
.video {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
}
```
